description: Find what to write next (content gaps): topics with search demand or audience questions that AI answers cover poorly. Returns AI answers, citations, keyword ideas, trends, Reddit and YouTube data; channels limits the sources. To brief one topic, use cite42_generate_content_brief. Charged only for the steps that succeed, at per-surface rates. Billed in USD (result field cite42Billing) to the user's prepaid Cite42 balance, and failed calls are free; exact prices from cite42_pricing (free). For plans over 20 calls or $5, estimate the cost and confirm with the user first.

fullSweep.description: Query all five AI surfaces (adds claude and google_ai_overview) for full cross-surface coverage, at a higher cost. Ignored when models is given.

models.description: AI surfaces to query, each billed separately; pass a subset when the user names surfaces or wants a lower cost. Omit for the defaults (chatgpt = the OpenAI API, perplexity, gemini); fullSweep queries all five. google_ai_overview accepts queries up to 700 characters, the others 2000.

topic.description: Market, niche, product category, or audience to research.

name: cite42_find_content_opportunities
